input.answer:
I can't answer this. Forecasting future values, such as Ontario's rent index in 2030, is outside what I can do with the Statistics Canada tools available to me, and I have not produced an estimate.

If you want historical data, the Consumer Price Index tables from Statistics Canada include Ontario and a rent component. A good starting point is the monthly CPI table (product 18-10-0004), which covers Ontario and is updated through 2026-09. Its source URL is https://www150.statcan.gc.ca/t1/tbl1/en/tv.action?pid=1810000401. I haven't checked the table's rent series yet, so confirm that the rent component is in there before relying on it.
